Project X si rivela una discreta commedia adolescenziale costruita con l'efficace espediente del falso documentario. Al di là della componente comica, il film propone una critica agli eccessi della gioventù e al bisogno quasi ossessivo di ottenere accettazione e popolarità. La gigantesca festa, dominata da alcol, droga e sesso, diventa così il simbolo di una ribellione adolescenziale destinata a sfuggire completamente di mano. La scelta di alternare riprese con telecamera a mano, cellulari e dashcam rende il racconto dinamico e immersivo, trasmettendo allo spettatore il progressivo deterioramento della situazione e la perdita di controllo dei protagonisti. È proprio attraverso questo caos crescente che il film racconta le conseguenze della ricerca esasperata di approvazione sociale. Il finale, volutamente sopra le righe, risulta forse fin troppo esagerato e poco credibile, ma si inserisce perfettamente nel tono folle e irriverente dell'opera. Nel complesso, Project X è una commedia divertente e coinvolgente che, dietro la sua leggerezza, riesce anche a offrire qualche spunto di riflessione sugli eccessi e sulle fragilità dell'adolescenza.

Im a sucker for movies that can only seem to exist in the exact moment in time in which they were created, or ones that capture the moment they’re depicting with perfection. I think of Nashville, Fast Times at Ridgemont High, Yi Yi, and Eddington (unfortunately). While this movie is nowhere near as good as those, I would argue that it captures its moment with far more specifity as those all have some relevance or takeaways that can still resonate. This is a cultural artifact that offers nothing more than a time capsule into the worst aspects of 2012 culture. That’s sounds harsh but considering I was the exact age/grade of the characters in this movie in 2012, I think I have a modest level of authority to speak on this topic. I think it’s really entertaining for the most part despite how unbelievable it was. But I’m not going to say it’s a good movie that holds up to time. It was never meant to be that anyway. That’s what makes it special. I should’ve poured a beer on my rug to fully immerse myself in the experience.

It’s certainly not a particularly brilliant film, but in its simplicity and sheer stupidity, it still manages to get more than a few laughs. More importantly, though, it captures the carefree nature of adolescence remarkably well, and more specifically, the culture of seeking fun through getting wasted that was so typical of Millennials. More than anything for its comedy, it works as a snapshot of a generation and a particular way of experiencing adolescence. A film that will probably resonate more with, and be more appreciated by, those who actually lived through that generation firsthand.

OH MY GOD I WANT TO GET SO WASTED RIGHT NOW. Gosh, words can't express how much I want to get in that damn party!!! Involve me, involve me! Get me in between those sweaty, drunk bodies ASAP. I've never lived out the American teenage party, but oh how I want to experience it so badly. Living vicariously through this movie because for the past few weeks I've been knee deep in my textbooks for exam season... god I hate it here. Really fucking needed this if you can't tell already. Restored all the energy I'll need for the whole week. Project X is a total craze ball!! There's not a single person in that town that didn't get absolutely fucked that night. There's vomit, piss, any type of bodily fluid to be honest. Yeah, it's pretty shitty as a movie, but its significance cannot be undermined -- the soundtrack and remixes from this movie was a cultural phenomenon, changed lives back in 2012. I still have no idea what was happening with the flamethrower guy, but that shit was.. something. Didn't expect for this party to get THAT out of hand, it was pure chaos, and fuck I'd be lying it I said I don't eat this type of shit up like a 3 course meal. Trust me when I say everything in this movie gets wackier by the second. So yeah, a hella entertaining movie. P.S: My La La Land poster finally came in!! 🥹💗 La La Land is my favourite movie EVER, so I'm quite literally on the moon rn. Project Hail Mary poster, you're next.
